scope: Top 10 cities by listing count in Massachusetts, Maine, New York, California, and Minnesota. Mailing-address groups outside the state were not part of this pass.
method: Every in-scope listing that has a website in the source data had that site fetched and read for an ownership sentence. California and Minnesota source files in this set do not include websites, so those listings were compared by business name to platform and franchise names and were not given a label without a page that states the relationship. A label is stored only with a short quote from a page opened on this date. Family-owned or a named owner-operator, with a year or generation on the same page, is the bar for independent. Locally owned, or in business since a year, without that sentence, stays unverified. A web search on this date for these business names with acquired or private equity did not return a report that one of the independent labels below had been sold.
